generic_root_cause: When carrier invoices are absent, Benefits Enrollment Reports (BER) serve as the primary invoice-equivalent billing document. BER files frequently aggregate multi-benefit lines (Dental, Vision, Life, Commuter, FSA) across hundreds of rows and lack a total premium column. Rejecting BERs for lack of premium columns generates false 'No invoice was provided' errors and inflates counts.
applicable_conditions: No standard monthly carrier billing statement provided in submission
Benefits Enrollment Report (BER) or Benefit Elections workbook is present
BER contains medical tier, coverage level, or employee pre-tax deduction amounts across multi-line products

conditions: BER not recognized as invoice or non-medical rows leak into subscriber invoice census

root_cause.summary: Classify BER as invoice-equivalent when no carrier invoice is present, accept subscriber election and tier columns without requiring total gross premium, and strictly filter out non-medical benefit lines.

preconditions: workbook classified as BER or benefit elections
exclusions: do not parse non-medical rows as medical invoice subscribers

promotion.reason: Validated against Feedback.docx Benefits Enrollment 2 acceptance as invoice equivalent
